@graph.name: Miami-Dade Home Owner's Loan Corporation (HOLC) Neighborhood Redlining Grade
@graph.description: The historical redlining grade from 143 cities across the United States. This dataset is the subset for Miami-Dade County in Florida.

additionalProperty.name: process_step
additionalProperty.value:
#########
  # GDSC ETL is performed in two steps: shell script to ETL data into postgres
  # and then additional transformations with SQL in postGIS (if needed).
  ####
  
  #########
  # Step 1 - bash script (pseudo code)
  ####
  
  # create directory structure and move into it
  mkdir -p /data/mdc_holc_redlining/download -p /data/mdc_holc_redlining/etl
  chmod -R 777 /data/mdc_holc_redlining
  cd /data/mdc_holc_redlining
  
  # set update flag based on last update and update frequency
  do_update=0 if date() < last_update + update_frequency else do_update = 1
  
  # download if update flag is set:
  if do_update == 1 then
  ogr2ogr -nln mdc_holc_redlining download/mdc_holc_redlining.geojson 'https://services.arcgis.com/jIL9msH9OI208GCb/ArcGIS/rest/services/HOLC_Neighborhood_Redlining/FeatureServer/0/query?where=city=%27Miami%27&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=json 2>&1'
  
  # load into postGIS with:
  ogr2ogr -lco GEOMETRY_NAME=geom -f PostgreSQL PG:"<postgres connection>" download/mdc_holc_redlining.geojson -nlt multipolygon -nln mdc_holc_redlining
  echo success: mdc_holc_redlining.geojson loaded with ogr2ogr
  
  
  #########
  # Step 2 - SQL script (pseudo code):
  ####
  
  # remove duplicate points and make geometries valid:
  UPDATE mdc_holc_redlining
    SET geom=ST_MakeValid(ST_RemoveRepeatedPoints(geom));
  
  # add local geometry column and reproject existing geometries into local EPSG:
  ALTER TABLE mdc_holc_redlining DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS geom_local CASCADE;
  SELECT AddGeometryColumn (
    'mdc_holc_redlining',
    'geom_local', 2236, 'multipolygon', 2
  );
  UPDATE mdc_holc_redlining
    SET geom_local=ST_MakeValid(ST_RemoveRepeatedPoints(ST_Transform(ST_Multi(geom),2236)));
  CREATE INDEX mdc_holc_redlining_geom_local_idx
    ON mdc_holc_redlining
    USING GIST (geom_local);
  NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
  # Move into corrrect directory and create derivative directory in data package on osgeo
  cd /data/mdc_holc_redlining/
  mkdir -p derived
  
  # Move into correct directory
  cd /data/mdc_holc_redlining/
  
  # Create pg_dump of table SQL in derivate directory on postgis.
  pg_dump <postgres opts> -h gaia-db -t mdc_holc_redlining > derived/mdc_holc_redlining.sql
  
  # Create downloadable tarfile of SQL in derivative directory on postgis
  rm -f derived/mdc_holc_redlining.sql.tar.gz
  tar -czf derived/mdc_holc_redlining.sql.tar.gz meta_dcat_mdc_holc_redlining.json -C derived mdc_holc_redlining.sql
